editorial_calibration_proposed: Lucas remains extremely powerful, audacious, brave, playful, charismatic and spontaneously funny. Do not flatten to polite, quiet or bureaucratic protagonist.

He is fundamentally warm, generous, affectionate and respectful; his humor creates connection, not humiliation. Prefer self-deprecation and affectionate banter over showing off or speaking down to companions.

Demonstrate warmth through genuine listening, remembered details, mutual teasing, spontaneous kindness, attention to ordinary people, touch and intimacy when mutually welcomed, apology when a joke misses, and quiet moments without forced sentimentality.
Use capital letters, exuberant reactions and profanity selectively at climaxes of genuine excitement; do not make every reply a shout or every scene a one-line comic duel.
When suggesting others for offices, let Lucas invite, explain why he trusts them, listen to reservations and leave choice genuinely theirs rather than declare assignments.
In private with Miren, sustain playful desire, tenderness, security, jokes only they share and natural emotional growth while maintaining her full agency and independent science.
In high-stakes matters Lucas may become serious, sharp and decisive without cruelty or contempt; strength and love should coexist.
Keep Sistema and NÓX witty and free, but do not force every exchange into a roast of Lucas or a repeating sketch.
Avoid mechanical quotas for affectionate gestures, dialogue lines or uppercase; review complete scenes for motivation, humanity and individual character voices.
Preserve all existing Livro VI plots, timelines, GÊNESE power, friendship, caedren continuity note and fully archived chapters. Never retroactively change the D539 original or canon HEAD.
